About street numbers & privacy

Gridway numbers are app references, separate from official street names and addresses. East and West street names have separate references. Numbered roads cover Manhattan; they do not provide a walking route.

Street shapes: NYC Open Data, Street Centerline, downloaded October 19, 2026. Road segments with the same name share one number. Map: © OpenStreetMap contributors.

Address searches are sent to NYC Planning’s GeoSearch service as you type or press search. Location is requested once when you tap the button; map providers receive the viewed area. Selected A and B coordinates are sent to FOSSGIS for walking routes; the provider logs requests. A device location selected as A is included. Nothing is persisted by this app.

Walking routes use FOSSGIS routing and OpenStreetMap data. Fix the map.
